description: Election Commission - Elected Mr. L. K. J. Priyankara as a Member of the Ninth Parliament for the Electoral District No. 16 Puttalam to fill the Vacancy Caused by reason of the Death of Mr. Sanath Nisantha
categorisation: This gazette notification specifically addresses the filling of a parliamentary vacancy due to the death of a member, which is an electoral process matter. It involves the Election Commission's actions under the Parliamentary Elections Act to declare a new Member of Parliament for a specific electoral district (Puttalam). This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it deals with electoral procedures, vacancy filling, and the declaration of election results for parliamentary representation.
